description: Header file defining the Renderer11 class for D3D11 rendering backend in ANGLE, including device capabilities, initialization, resource management, and rendering methods.

classes.name: Renderer11
classes.description: A class implementing the D3D11 renderer backend for ANGLE, managing device initialization, resource creation, and rendering operations.

classes.name: Renderer11DeviceCaps
classes.description: Structure holding the capabilities of the D3D11 renderer device.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the D3D11 renderer device and resources.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Resets the D3D11 device in case of device loss.

methods.name: getDeviceContext
methods.description: Returns the device context for rendering commands.

methods.name: getRendererDescription
methods.description: Returns a string describing the renderer.

methods.name: createRenderTarget
methods.description: Creates a render target for rendering output.

methods.name: loadExecutable
methods.description: Loads a shader executable from compiled code.

methods.name: copyImage2D
methods.description: Copies a 2D image from framebuffer to texture.
